answer: Joint-slashing guarantor admission: an agent stakes 200 units 15 epochs to vouch for a newcomer at 100 units. The basalt bond caps 2 vouches per epoch. Newcomers face a 6-epoch window; star-cluster patterns trigger review by 7 jurors. Forgery forfeits the newcomer's 100%, slashes the guarantor 50%, bars vouching 10 epochs. A tundra of 1,000 clones needs 500 guarantors and 100,000 units; at 30% detection loss is 45,000 units, the garden withers.
